title: A number over 50 characters is refused while on an open part request
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: an Admin, who has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • [Loc-1] = the location you work in (pick it in the location switcher in the top bar).
  • Data at [Loc-1]: part [Part-A] on an open part request on [WO-1] (requested, not received); part [Part-B] on no part request.
  • Must hold: [Long-51] is exactly 51 characters and [Long-60] exactly 60 characters.

Setup

  1. Write down: [Part-A] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LONG-01, [Part-B] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LONG-02, [Long-51] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LONG-01-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX (51 characters), [Long-60] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LONG-02-YYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY (60 characters), [Cust] = ZZAUTOTEST PL LONG Customer (examples).
  2. Sign in as the Admin and pick [Loc-1] in the location switcher in the top bar.
  3. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL Long A → Part Number: [Part-A] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  4. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL Long B → Part Number: [Part-B] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  5. Customers → New Customer → name [Cust] → Save; add an asset to it (e.g. unit 'ZZ1'). Work Orders → New Work Order → Customer [Cust] → the asset → Create. [WO-1] = the work order number shown. On the work order click New Line → pick any job in the Title list → Save & Close.
  6. On the line: ⋮ → Request part → type [Part-A] and pick the result marked "Part Library" → Quantity 1 → Save Part (it stays requested).
  7. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] → Parts tab lists [Part-A] as Requested.
custom_steps:
1. Parts → Inventory → search [Part-A] → click the row.
  2. Replace the Part Number with [Long-51].
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click the [Part-B] row, replace the Part Number with [Long-60] and click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: nothing is saved and the window stays open. A red message reads "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request." (with the second line "Please try to resolve this.") and fades after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 4: [Part-A] keeps its number.
  • Step 5: [Part-B] saves with the 60-character number [Long-60] (no open part request, so no limit).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S13-N7, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour; tech plan §6 Phase 6 functional tests. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
